title: The Little Pirate and the Sticky Anchor
summary: A little pirate and his tiny crew set sail for a picnic on Shell Island, but their anchor gets stuck in seaweed. Pulling harder fails, so the pirate thinks like an engineer, builds a simple pulley winch from a wooden spool and rope, frees the anchor, and enjoys a gentle treasure picnic before sailing home under the stars.
